Name: OnlyShane - Shane Expansion
Author: jkysa88
Description:
[b]💙 OnlyShane: A Real Romance[/b]

Love is, in the end, the deep choice of one person.


A romance rewrite that treats Shane as a real partner; across stranger(Incomplete)→friend(Incomplete)→lover→family, his [b]voice, affection, and growth[/b] change over time.

[b]English localization is provided for accessibility; the Korean version is the reference for tone and voice.[/b]

awkward translations: feedback and bug reports are welcome.
feedback and bug reports are welcome.

[b]Localization Guide (Brief)[/b]

Mature, self-aware, dry humor, sincere — casual register; avoid flowery metaphors or teenish tone.

[b]Looking for an English translator (volunteer)
[/b]
Korean is the original language. I’m looking for help creating a higher-quality English localization.
Scope can be partial (README + key events / post-marriage lines only).
If you’re interested, please comment or DM me.

[SONG]
English subtitles for the Korean song have been added to the default.json file.

[b]/ Highlights

• JojaMart dialogue isn’t locked to one line per day. Talking again can produce a different line depending on the situation.[/b]
• 6[i],000+ Dialogue[/i]
•[i]Evolving romance, steady and real[/i]
• [i]Post-marriage growth, not loops[/i]
• [i]Festivals & vanilla events reimagined/New Song Event[/i]
•  [i]Seasonal habits; weekday/weekend routines[/i]
•  [i]Gift reactions that respect his past[/i]
•[i]Spouse room makeover (10–14 hearts)[/i]

[b]  Requirements[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37749]Marriage Dialogue Unlocker Tool
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20938]﻿Custom Fixed Dialogue - Continued[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35027]StardewCGEvents[/url]

[b] Installation[/b]

Install SMAPI and the required mods, extract this mod to Stardew Valley/Mods, then launch the game.

[b]Compatibility[/b]

May conflict with mods editing Characters/Dialogue/Shane or MarriageDialogueShane. Portrait retextures (texture-only) are generally compatible.

[b]Optional Add-on[/b]
Only items listed in this section are optional. Everything else in the main archive is required.

[b]BouquetRejectAll (DLL)[/b] — optionally restricts the bouquet and Mermaid Pendant to Shane only.


[b]IMPORTANT (DLL files inside this archive)
[/b]
This mod pack includes multiple [b].dll[/b] files.
[b]All DLLs included in the archive are required[/b] unless explicitly listed under [b]Optional Add-on[/b].
Do not remove or cherry-pick DLLs, or SMAPI errors may occur.
[b]
 [/b]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38734]JojaMartCGsong,
[/url]This mod adds the event CG song to JojaMart. It works standalone, too.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39565]PlayerStatusMod[/url]
Adds extra dialogue that reacts to player conditions, only when Player Status Mod is installed.
Not required for the main dialogue. Missing it won’t cause errors; it only disables this add-on’s dialogue.
